series_end_reason: Alexion was acquired by AstraZeneca on 21 July 2021 and stopped reporting; the AstraZeneca continuation is delivered as astrazeneca_soliris_alt (from 2021Q4; the 2021Q3 stub from 21 July is not a full quarter).
notes: Launch: Q1 2007 release states Soliris was approved by FDA on 16 March 2007 and 'the Company began commercial sale of Soliris in the U.S. during April 2007' (Ex.99.1 of 8-K 0001193125-07-098784). Through 2015Q2 the table row 'Net product sales' is Soliris only (Alexion's sole marketed product); from 2015Q3 the 'Soliris' / 'Total Soliris' row is used because other products were added. 2014Q1 includes $87.8m for reimbursement of prior-year shipments as printed.
search_log: listed Alexion (CIK 0000899866) filings via data.sec.gov submissions incl. filings.files older pages: 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A all counted; Alexion changed from a July to a December fiscal year in 2005, so calendar quarters are used from 2007
